questions.question: What did the people do at the end of the confession?
options: Scattered and went back to their towns
Crowned a king to rule over them
Fled the city in fear of attack
Made and sealed a binding covenant
questions.answer: Made and sealed a binding covenant

questions.question: What were three things the people pledged in the covenant?
options: To rebuild the walls, to crown a new king, and to gather a large army together
To pay regular tribute to Persia, to fast often, and to keep completely silent
To free all of their many slaves, to forgive all debts, and to leave the land to rest
Not to intermarry with the peoples, to keep the Sabbath, and to support the temple
questions.answer: Not to intermarry with the peoples, to keep the Sabbath, and to support the temple

questions.question: The people promised not to neglect the house of their God.
They took an oath to walk in God's _____ given by Moses.
They cast lots to bring the wood offering and the _____ of their ground to the temple.
